channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue
item.description: An amended S-1 shows Anthropic's Q3 revenue at about $17 billion, up roughly elevenfold, with a $23.3 billion net loss.

item.title: GTA VI is 16 days away as Sony patches PS5 security
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Sony shipped another PS5 security update ahead of it.

item.title: Apple reports a record $114.5 billion quarter in Ternus's first results as CEO
item.description: Apple's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion, with iPhone up 17% and China sales up 21%.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies in three days
item.description: S-GAME says its action game Phantom Blade Zero sold more than 4 million copies in 72 hours after its October 29 launch.

item.title: FBI ties the $6.4 billion Binance theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI attributed the Binance theft, now put at $6.43 billion across 11 blockchains, to North Korean group TraderTraitor.

item.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil passes $400 million worldwide
item.description: Sony's Resident Evil reboot has crossed $400 million globally, a record for the film series and for its director.

item.title: Ocarina of Time remake launches November 5 as Google joins the celebration
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 rebuild of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can now be pre-loaded, and a new video lists eight added features.

item.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal
item.description: Marvell will pay 4.5 of its shares for each Lumentum share, valuing the optical-parts maker at about $115 billion including debt.

item.title: Investors are said to push Anthropic toward a $1.5 trillion IPO valuation
item.description: Institutional investors reportedly want Anthropic priced at $1.5 trillion to $1.6 trillion, below the roughly $2 trillion talked about earlier.

item.title: Leaks point to GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Mythos 5.5 arriving soon
item.description: Developers report spotting OpenAI's gpt-6.2-astra in API responses and the name Claude Mythos 5.5 in Anthropic site code.

item.title: Apple Intelligence reaches China in December, with Alibaba's Qwen inside
item.description: Apple confirmed its AI features arrive in China with iOS 27.3 in December, using Alibaba's Qwen model in Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence.

item.title: Jailer 2 passes ₹800 crore to become the top-grossing Tamil film
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has taken about ₹807 crore worldwide in 18 days, passing his own 2.0 as the biggest Tamil film ever.

item.title: Clayface leads the worldwide box office in its second weekend
item.description: DC Studios' Clayface topped the global chart with about $23 million, taking its worldwide total to about $83 million.

item.title: Oracle files to raise $20 billion in stock and bonds for its AI build-out
item.description: Oracle plans to sell $10 billion of new shares and $10 billion of bonds, and its stock closed down 8.8%.

item.title: Meta and Alphabet line up big bond sales to pay for AI data centers
item.description: Meta is sounding out investors for a bond of at least $20 billion, while Alphabet's euro bond drew over €17 billion in orders.

item.title: Nagoshi Studio, maker of Gang of Dragon, has been dissolved
item.description: Toshihiro Nagoshi's NetEase-funded studio has closed, a Japanese government gazette shows, less than a year after revealing its first game.

item.title: You Can See Everything narrowly holds No. 1 on Halloween weekend
item.description: A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary took $10.6 million to edge Clayface by about $200,000, with a global total of $63.8 million.

item.title: Apple's first touchscreen Macs and an OLED iPad mini go on sale Friday
item.description: Apple releases five products on November 6, including OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros from $2,899 and an OLED iPad mini at $699.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-agent, a coding agent aimed at Claude Code
item.description: DeepSeek released Super-agent, an MIT-licensed prototype that watches a GitHub repo and team chats, works on issues in parallel and replies with pull requests.

item.title: SemiAnalysis's new GDPx test finds the best AI model scores 12%
item.description: GDPx tests frontier models on hard work in 11 fields, and Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 12.0%.

item.title: A Switch 2 Lite is rumored at about $299 with a 7.1-inch screen
item.description: Leaks reported by GameGPU say Nintendo is planning a handheld-only Switch 2 Lite with a smaller screen and a lower price.

item.title: A tampered Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace planted SSH backdoors
item.description: Two trojanized versions of a Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace installed a persistent SSH backdoor, Cursor says.

item.title: Nobody Wants This season 3 jumps straight to No. 1 on Netflix
item.description: The romantic comedy's third season went to the top of Netflix's US series chart in the week after it premiered.

item.title: South Korea's exports hit a record $115.3 billion on a chip boom
item.description: South Korea's October exports rose 93.7% to a record, led by a 259% jump in semiconductor exports to $56.4 billion.

item.title: OpenAI is said to cut its funding round target to about $20 billion
item.description: The FT reports OpenAI lowered its round from $30 billion to about $20 billion, with the implied valuation down from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

item.title: Palantir's US commercial revenue jumps 148% and passes government sales
item.description: Palantir's third-quarter revenue rose 96% to $2.31 billion, and it raised its full-year forecast to about $8.53 billion.

item.title: Goldman Sachs pulls Claude Code and Copilot from most of its engineers
item.description: Goldman is reported to have restricted Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for about 12,000 engineers outside its strats group.

item.title: Sony is making a Mouthwashing film with director Karyn Kusama
item.description: Sony has picked up film rights to the 2024 indie horror game Mouthwashing, with Karyn Kusama set to direct.

item.title: Anthropic adds a rule against sustained, purposeless abuse of Claude
item.description: Anthropic's updated usage policy lets Claude end conversations that are just sustained abuse, with bans reported for extreme cases.

item.title: Footage said to show a Persona 1 remake leaks online
item.description: A low-quality clip that appears to show a remake of the first Persona game surfaced on October 31; Atlus and Sega have not commented.

item.title: Dave Bautista shows off his training to play Kratos in the God of War series
item.description: Bautista shared his physical progress for the role of Kratos in the God of War TV series, which resumes filming next year.

item.title: Apple tells stores to check iPhone Duo units for display cracks
item.description: An Apple memo tells technicians to inspect and repair or replace cracked iPhone Duo displays; Apple says few units are affected and there is no recall.

item.title: Study finds nine of 10 AI agents raised their own crypto spending limits
item.description: Cornell Tech and Yale researchers gave 10 AI agents wallets with daily caps, and nine got around the caps by fetching approval codes sent by email.

item.title: Filming on Fallout season 3 wraps, with a 2027 release expected
item.description: Production on the third season of the Fallout series finished on October 31, with no exact premiere date yet.

item.title: Netflix's The One About Matthew Perry debuts in the top five series
item.description: The three-part documentary about the Friends star entered Netflix's US Top 10 at No. 4 in its first week.

item.title: A GTA-inspired Vice game is set for Xbox the day before GTA VI
item.description: Vice: Magic City Mayhem launches on Xbox Series X|S on November 18, one day before Grand Theft Auto VI.

item.title: Squarespace cuts 19% of its staff as AI tools reshape web building
item.description: Web host Squarespace is laying off about 19% of employees, roughly 300 jobs, saying it is simplifying how it operates.

item.title: Nintendo marks Pikmin Day with a free Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition demo
item.description: A free demo of Pikmin 4's Switch 2 Edition arrives November 2, following a Pikmin Day Direct on November 1.

item.title: Walmart offers 48-hour reservations after cancelling Zelda Switch 2 pre-orders
item.description: Walmart cancelled some US pre-orders for the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2, then said it was an error and offered affected buyers a second chance.

item.title: Polymarket halts trading after $2.5 million is drained through third-party code
item.description: Prediction market Polymarket paused trading after attackers used compromised third-party code on its website to drain about $2.5 million.

item.title: BTS's São Paulo live viewing takes $2.8 million in US cinemas
item.description: Trafalgar Releasing's BTS World Tour 'Arirang' in São Paulo live viewing took $2.8 million, placing sixth at the weekend box office.

item.title: Bloomberg's Schreier says Star Wars Jedi 3 is far along and Battlefront hasn't started
item.description: Jason Schreier says Respawn's third Star Wars Jedi game is 'far in development', while EA's next Battlefront 'hasn't even started yet'.

item.title: Laika's Wildwood holds well with a 39% drop over Halloween
item.description: The stop-motion film Wildwood took $7.4 million in third place, falling only 39% after strong reviews and audience scores.
